transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-lock round-robin underway so we can move toward final production approval. Could I ask each of the technical, rights, talent, and accessibility leads to report their final operating requirements for the gala broadcast package? I want to make sure we address any outstanding issues before I sign off on the binding approval.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical finding from my RF survey. The wireless roaming camera links interfere with the theater's assistive-listening loop, so the gala must use three fixed wired cameras from the marked camera platforms instead of any wireless roaming setup. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but it's not on Mara's draft lock sheet yet, so I want to make sure it's formally captured before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a critical rights issue to report. I received the countersigned performance license this morning, and it permits the gala broadcast but explicitly prohibits any video-on-demand release or later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. I have not yet entered this restriction in the rights tracker, so I want it formally captured now. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision permitting the recording to be reused in the festival archive, since that would constitute a use beyond the broadcast.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have two critical talent requirements to report. First, I confirmed with the headliner's agent that the performer can soundcheck only at exactly 3:00 PM on Saturday — this is not yet reflected in the production schedule. Second, and more critically, the headliner's rider explicitly prohibits sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage. I have the agent's confirmation in email. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision that includes a sponsor product display on stage. That sponsor display must be removed from the stage area before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I have a critical accessibility requirement to report. My accessibility vendor confirmed that the live caption feed requires the captioner to work from Booth B, whose dedicated return feed is connected to the gala's caption encoder. The general plan's control-room location will not work for the caption feed. I documented the vendor confirmation in the accessibility file, but I have not yet added the booth assignment to the lock sheet, so I want it formally captured before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A5
